metadata.case_name: SIN KIN MAN v. HSIN CHEONG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: light duty jobs of a repetitive nature such as data entry or a messenger job

injuries.description: a head injury causing a scalp abrasion, broken teeth and concussion with transient loss of conciousness
source: a head injury causing a scalp abrasion, broken teeth and concussion with transient loss of conciousness
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with loss of consciousness, short duration of less than 30 minutes

injuries.description: a hyperflexion injury to the cervical spine causing lower motor neurone lesion in both upper limbs
source: a hyperflexion injury to the cervical spine causing lower motor neurone lesion in both upper limbs
injuries.icd_description: Central cord syndrome of cervical spinal cord

injuries.description: a soft tissue injury to the cervical spine
source: a soft tissue injury to the cervical spine
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine

manifestations.description: cognitive impairment and impairment of intellectual functioning
decreased sensation in the C8 dermatomes on both sides
mild weakness in both upper limbs
grade 3+ weakness and poor dexterity in the ulnar fingers of both hands
pain and severe stiffness in the cervical spine
post-concussional syndrome (symptoms of headache, dizziness, memory impairment, irritability, poor temper control)

treatments_received: physiotherapy (24 sessions from 14 August 2002 to 23 January 2003)
admission to Tuen Mun Hospital (multiple admissions)
treatments_future: intensive daily physiotherapy for a period of 6 to 8 weeks
2 sessions of psychological counselling per month for 2 years
psychiatric treatment with medication for a further 2 years

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Physical injuries have interfered with pre-accident hobbies, including playing football and swimming and taking his daughter out.
Injuries have affected the harmony of his married life; became irritable and withdrawn; sexual relations curtailed until last year due to pain.
Lost most of his social and recreational activities; lost interest and drive to go out with friends.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Sexual activity reduced to near zero at one stage because neck and head pain made him unable to continue.
Unable to resume work as an assistant site supervisor; can only perform light duties or repetitive jobs.
